title.value: Local Structure Matters Most: Perturbation Study in NLU
title.justification: The value was chosen because it matches the title provided in the task for analysis, identifying the focus of the study as related to natural language understanding and perturbations.
title.quote: Local Structure Matters Most: Perturbation Study in NLU

extractions.description: This paper explores the impact of local and global perturbations on neural language models, particularly focusing on character-level and subword-level perturbations. It finds that neural models primarily rely on the local structure of text, with little use of global ordering. The study examines various types of perturbations to understand their effects on model performance in natural language understanding tasks.
